Testing Library/RASP
United States · Armed forces

RASP

Ranger Assessment and Selection Program

SELECTION TEST

At a glance

The U.S. Army lists a 12-mile ruck as part of RASP. It is one part of a longer selection process, alongside running, swimming and other activities.

FEATURED ACTIVITY12-mile ruck35 lb dry pack · no time listed on current overview

What the test includes

  • 12-mile ruck with a 35 lb dry pack
  • Five-mile run under 40 minutes
  • 15 m swim in uniform
  • Other entry and selection activities

Some programmes include more than the activities listed here.

Official test instructions

The organisation running the test is the best place to check the latest rules and requirements.

Visit U.S. Army
REFERENCE

U.S. Army. (n.d.). Army Rangers. https://www.goarmy.com/careers-and-jobs/specialty-careers/special-ops/army-rangers

Worth knowing

  • The current public overview lists the distance and pack weight but does not publish a time limit for this ruck.
  • This page is a quick introduction, not a complete entry guide.
